transcript: It's going to be a 12 hour road closure today. So they will escort me out because they're going to do testing of the rocket. What if Elon comes while I'm away? This is day 8 of living outside SpaceX until Elon Musk give me a hug. And the police officer brought me to a gas station to have my first shower. Bro, you are the best. This is your shower number? It's finally time! This is the best! Oh man. You can see in my face how much joy a shower brought. I couldn't believe it. After my shower, the same police officer came back for this. This is a lot of food, man. Best policeman in the world. All the day today I was working to a master plant and I will tell you tomorrow. The road is still closed. After the road opened, I didn't have a way to go back. So I called the police officer from the port. He's going to pick me up. There are good policemen!
metadata_caption: Day 8 of trying to hug Elon Musk
